frozen_baseline_measured.s4_witness: R3 predictor gives peak_velocity 0.47; cradle tolerates 0.263

architecture.closed_loop_rollout: new continuous rollout closed_loop_rollout(snap, controller, cfg); branches rl once; reuses _schedule_increment + step_ablation + govern_torque + identical K6/peak/contact accounting; returns rollout_primitive-shaped metrics dict
architecture.anti_divergence_golden: constant-controller closed_loop_rollout == rollout_primitive(snap, theta) bit-identical on all 4 teacher states

frozen.predictor: R3 NW kernel regression over 6 dev cradles [14250,14750,16500,17750,19500,24000]

forbidden: K6 or future value as controller input
pin/teleport/coin-state edit/snapshot restoration of the executed trajectory

energy_stopping.guard: d_stop > d_safe  (mass-free, numerically equivalent to E_kin > W_brake_available); tiny/zero authority floored conservatively

correction_law_rules.A_over_speed: d_stop>d_safe or E_kin>W_brake => down peak_velocity, down forward_drive, up braking_demand, earlier brake_entry; never up forward
correction_law_rules.B_under_speed: insufficient progress & healthy margins => up forward_drive conservatively, keep safe margin
correction_law_rules.C_contact_risk: Fn/margin dropping or separation growing => up squeeze, down forward_drive; no aggressive lateral
correction_law_rules.D_cross_track_spin: target-frame v_perp/perp-disp/spin => update lateral, mirror-equivariant sign
correction_law_rules.E_release: frozen causal guard (dtz, coin speed, stopping margin, contact, min dwell-safety); never K6 result

phase_guards.mechanism: timing-clamp effective theta so _schedule_increment yields phase >= floor; corrections may bring brake earlier but never revert BRAKE->PUSH

search_budget.budget_zero_meaning: direct execution of theta0 = pure closed-loop, no search
search_budget.candidate_is: a full continuous closed-loop trajectory from snap

honesty_control.load_bearing_if: closed-loop strictly beats R3 open-loop at the same budget (ideally budget 0)

dev_only_tuning_C1.selection_criterion: dev K6 = 2/2 with smallest/most-conservative params; tie -> largest safe stopping margin

frozen_panel_C2.hard_gate: total 4/4, dev 2/2, held-out 2/2, one continuous trajectory/state, budget<=8, no motion/collision/contract violation, provenance valid
